title: Netflix’s Biggest Martial Arts Anime Returns With a Wild Look Ahead of Anime’s Return
content:
The critically acclaimed sequel series of the Baki franchise returned with a brand new chapter in February this year as part of the Winter 2026 anime lineup. One of the biggest anime on Netflix is the Baki franchise, an acclaimed martial arts series based on the manga by Keisuke Itagaki. Regardless of the controversies and the wild moments in the series, there’s no denying that Baki is one of the most successful and long-standing anime and manga franchises of all time. The previous part of the story, Baki Hanma , aired two seasons before returning with Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai this year. Following the first cour of Season 1, the anime returned with new episodes with the second part in June.

The series was again a massive hit, gathering millions of views across the globe within the first few days of its release. However, Baki’s journey is far from over , and fans will get to watch even more intense battles in the future. While fans await the anime’s return, the official website drops a gorgeous new Ukiyo-e visual by illustrator KOJIMAN. The visual features the thrilling battle between Baki and Musashi, the main antagonist of the Baki-Dou series. While the anime is already available on Netflix, the visual hypes the anime’s broadcast in Japan.

What’s Next for the Baki Franchise?

While Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai only aired two cours of the anime, it covers the entire 22 volumes of the manga. The anime did suffer from some pacing issues and removal of scenes from the manga, but it remained faithful to the original story and reached a fairly conclusive end. However, the manga franchise is still ongoing thanks to new sequels which are expected to be adapted soon. It’s probably too early to decide what the future of the franchise holds, especially since the next big project is a spin-off instead of the continuation of the main story.

Around the end of August, Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaioh Doesn’t Mind Being Reincarnated in Another World At All!!! was confirmed for 2027. It’s an isekai spin-off focusing on Retsu , who wakes up in a new fantasy world after dying in his fight against Musashi Miyamoto seen in the main series. The manga is originally written by the original creator Keisuke Itagaki, while Eiji Mutusi handles the illustration. Although the anime doesn’t have a release window yet, we can expect more updates in the coming months.

Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai Wraps Up Another Major Battle

The story takes place after Baki earns the title of the World’s Strongest Boy in Baki Hanma. He spends his days in boredom waiting for a worthy opponent ever since the feud with his demon father ended. He is easily able to defend his title in Kourakuken Underground Arena while being dissatisfied with the skills of anyone he fights, which is why he hasn’t found a worthy opponent since then. However, things take a drastic turn when Musashi Miyamoto, a powerful fighter, is successfully cloned and brought to the modern era. He began challenging all famous fighting icons in Tokyo to test the limits of his own strength. Before long, Baki and Musashi come face to face as the protagonist does everything he can to defend his title as the strongest.

title: Hideaki Anno, Yutaka Izubuchi Co-Direct 'Uchuu Senkan Yamato √2199' Anime Movie
content:
An official website opened for the new Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Space Battleship Yamato ) anime project on Tuesday, revealing its official title, main staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). Titled Uchuu Senkan Yamato √2199 ( Cosmoship Yamato √2199 ), the project will be a feature-length anime movie. A premiere date has yet to be announced.

Staff Original Work: Yoshinobu Nishizaki ( Uchuu Senkan Yamato original co-creator) Director, Design Works: Hideaki Anno ( Shinseiki Evangelion ), Yutaka Izubuchi ( RahXephon ) Planning: Hideaki Anno, Mitsuhisa Ishikawa ( Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These ) Executive Producer: Hideaki Anno Studio: Production I.G , Khara Production: Shin Office Academy

Hideaki Anno stated that Uchuu Senkan Yamato √2199 is being developed separately and will take a different path from the remakes.

Leiji Matsumoto launched the original Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Space Battleship Yamato ) manga in October 1974 alongside the original television anime, ending it after three volumes in December 1979. Matsumoto serialized the Shin Uchuu Senkan Yamato manga from April 2000 to April 2001. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the original manga in English and released it as an omnibus in April 2019.

Michio Murakawa began serializing the Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2199 remake in March 2012. Dark Horse Comics licensed the remake in English in January 2019 and released the second omnibus volume in March 2020.

The original Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Star Blazers: The Quest for Iscandar ) television anime aired in 26 episodes from October 1974 to March 1975, followed by the sequel anime Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2 ( Star Blazers: The Comet Empire ) from October 1978 to April 1979.

The new Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Space Battleship Yamato ) project—rebooting the 1974 anime series—began with the Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2199 ( Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 2199 ) original video anime series that ran in 2012–2013. The Hoshimeguru Hakobune ( Odyssey of the Celestial Ark ) side story movie opened in December 2014.

The 26-episode Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2202: Ai no Senshi-tachi ( Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 2202 ) OVA ran between February 2017 and March 2019. The Seireki 2202-nen no Sentaku ( Star Blazers Chronicle 2202 ) compilation movie, reconstructing Yamato 2199 and Yamato 2202 from a new perspective, screened in June 2021.

The remake project continued with Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2205: Aratanaru Tabidachi , which released in two parts theatrically in October 2021 and February 2022.

The latest installment in the franchise, Yamato yo, Towa ni: Rebel 3199 ( Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 3199 ), debuted in July 2024, served as a sequel to Aratanaru Tabidachi . Reconstructing Yamato yo Towa ni ( Be Forever Yamato ) and Uchuu Senkan Yamato III ( Star Blazers: The Bolar Wars ), the movie project will screen in seven parts for 26 episodes, with the seventh and final part scheduled to premiere on October 30.

title: Hirayasumi Manga to End in 2 More Chapters
content:
This year's 45th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine announced on Monday that Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga will end in two more chapters. If there are no delays, the manga will end on October 19.

Viz Media is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward. At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life. After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old woman who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin, Natsumi, moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto's easygoing lifestyle to the test.

Shinzō launched the manga in Weekly Big Comic Spirits in April 2021. Shogakukan published the manga's 10th compiled book volume on April 30, and the series has over 1.1 million copies in circulation worldwide. Viz Media released the ninth volume on May 19. The manga was nominated for the 15th Manga Taisho awards in January 2022, ranked #18 in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in December 2022, nominated for the 27th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in February 2023, and nominated for Best Continuing Manga Series in the 2nd American Manga Awards.

The manga inspired a live-action series , which premiered on NHK in November 2025.

The manga is also inspiring a television anime that will premiere in January 2027 in Japan on the NHK General channel. Viz Media announced a 2027 release in English. Viz Media is co-producing the anime with Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions Co., Ltd and Production +h.

Denpa has licensed Shinzō's Holiday Junction collection of short manga. The book contains seven one-shot manga. Shogakukan shipped the book in Japan in July 2016.

title: Shonen Jump’s Latest Ending Manga Reaches Its Climax With a Twist No One Saw Coming
content:
Shonen Jump will be ending its fifth major series of 2026 very soon, but before that, it has incorporated a twist that perfectly matches the manga’s tone. 2026 has been an interesting year for Shonen Jump, with the magazine continuing its pattern of debuting new series while many are getting canceled as well. However, the interesting part was how the magazine had already confirmed at the start of the year that five major series would be coming to an end. It started with Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s sequel, Modulo , coming to an end, and in the same month, fans saw Chainsaw Man come to an end as well.

Following that was Black Clover ending its run, with the most recent being Blue Box in July. However, one major series that was still in its final fight was Sakamoto Days , which announced last July that it had entered its final battle. After Blue Box ‘s conclusion, Shonen Jump announced that the series had entered the final stage of this fight , and now, with the developments in the recent chapters, the series is indeed in its final phases. In particular, the latest chapter of Sakamoto Days , Chapter 277, “Whatever It Takes,” incorporates a comical twist that perfectly matches the tone of the series while also seemingly progressing the conclusion rapidly.

Shonen Jump’s Fifth Ending Series of 2026 Hits Its Climax With the Perfect Comical Twist

It has been a few chapters since Sakamoto entered the final fray against Slur ; however, there was still a reason needed for why the other world-class assassins who were on par with Sakamoto couldn’t defeat him, but the titular protagonist could. The reason for that has been revealed in the latest chapter, and it’s the perfect comical twist that matches what the series has presented throughout its narrative. The latest chapter features Aoi, Sakamoto’s wife, surprising him with some news, which Sakamoto initially thought was about a divorce: she is pregnant. This immediately boosts Sakamoto’s motivation, unveiling an unparalleled power as he lands a punch on Slur.

Sakamoto expresses that his main motive is seeing his daughter, Hana, become an older sister, and for this, whatever it takes, he is going to defeat Slur. This is the perfect comical yet emotional twist that matches what Sakamoto Days has always represented. It has always been about featuring the closeness of family, as Sakamoto’s presence has also infected others with the same energy. None other than the deuteragonist, Shin, is the perfect example, as he has evolved into an assassin far better than the world-class ones by learning from his master. With the latest twist, fans will get to see Shin and Sakamoto taking on Slur.

It is already easy to see where the ending is heading as well, with Sakamoto and Shin eventually teaching Slur about the notion of family and friends, making him realize that what he lost was actually everything that he wanted. Honestly, there couldn’t have been a more perfect way to wrap up this ending. With such a simple notion, Sakamoto Days has emerged as one of the biggest Shonen Jump series, running longer than even Jujutsu Kaisen , as it consistently depicts its themes, and it is nice to see that the series is doing the same with its conclusion before its ending very soon in the upcoming issues of the magazine.

title: Mackenyu Will Appear at London MCM Comic Con on October
content:
The MCM London Comic Con has announced on its X/Twitter feed that the actor Mackenyu , who plays Roronoa Zoro in the live-action One Piece webseries, will appear at the event which runs from Friday October 23 to Sunday October 25. The venue is London's ExCel Centre.

Mackenyu will appear on the Saturday and Sunday. He will participate in autograph and photo sessions ( details ), as well as a panel on the Sunday.

As well as Roronoa Zoro in the live-action One Piece webseries, Mackenyu plays Arata Wataya in the live-action Chihayafuru films, Seiya in the live-action Knights of the Zodiac film and Enishi in the live-action film Rurouni Kenshin Saishūshō The Final .

The following anime-related events are scheduled at October's MCM London Comic Con:

Friday

5 p.m. to 5.45 p.m. - "Getting Supernatural with DanDaDan" on the Live Stage, a panel featuring the dub actors A.J. Beckles (Okarun) and Kari Wahlgren (Granny Seiko).

Sunday

1.30 p.m. - Mackenyu Panel on the main stage. The panel is described as follows: "Join Mackenyu as he talks about bringing one of anime's most iconic characters to life, the training and preparation behind Zoro's legendary swordsmanship, working on the Netflix series, and his journey as an actor."

3 p.m. to 3.45 p.m. - Anime Limited Industry Panel featuring Andy Hanley and Tomi Murphy.

4 p.m. to 4.45 p.m. - Hunting Monsters with Jujutsu Kaisen on the Live Stage featuring the dub actors Anne Yatco (Nobara Kugisaki), David Vincent (Kento Nanami) and Allegra Clark (Kazumi Miwa, Maki Zenin).

title: Hindi Dub of Assassination Classroom Anime Streams on YouTube
content:
The first 22-episode season of the Assassination Classroom anime based on Yūsei Matsui 's manga of the same name premiered in Japan in January 2015. The second season of the anime premiered in January 2016. Muse Asia streamed the full first season of the anime in India on February 18.

The Tamil and Telugu dubs of the anime began streaming on Crunchyroll in February 2024. Crunchyroll began streaming both the first and second seasons of the anime as a free title in India in May 2024. The Hindi dub of the first and second seasons of the anime began streaming on Crunchyroll in August 2024. JioHotstar added the anime in May 2024. Netflix , Amazon Prime Video 's Anime Times and MX Player, and Sony Liv are also streaming the anime in India.

Muse India describes the story:

Tucked in the mountains near the elite Kunugigaoka Middle School lies a small derelict building that houses the delinquents and dropouts of Class 3-E. Looked down upon by their peers, the students in this class appear to have little hope in advancing their academic careers. That is, until the national government tasks them with eliminating the greatest threat to their planet: their new teacher. Having already destroyed the moon, the octopus-like professor—dubbed "Koro-sensei"—has now threatened to destroy the Earth by March of the following year. In light of their mission, the students have found that killing him is easier said than done. Not only can Koro-sensei move at speeds of up to Mach 20, but he can also resist almost every earthly weapon. Ironically, he also proves to be one of the best teachers Class 3-E has ever had. Training the class to excel in both their studies as students and skills as assassins, Koro-sensei is confident that his students' ingenuity and indomitable will could return them to the main campus. Through trial and error, Nagisa Shiota, as well as the other students of Class 3-E, must figure out Koro-sensei's weaknesses—and fast, for the very fate of the world depends upon it

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses New Battle Spirts, 'Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume' Anime
content:
Ani-One Asia announced on Monday that it has licensed the Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai no Kū , Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume , and Super Psychic Policeman Chojo anime.

Ani-One Asia will debut the stream for Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai no Kū , a new television anime series in Bandai's Battle Spirits multimedia franchise , on October 6 at 11:15 p.m. GMT +8. Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Keio Year 3, Hinomoto Edo, a stormy era later known as the Bakumatsu. A life-risking duel known as "Eternal", a battle permitted only to samurai. And among the common people, a "Standard Battle" without the stakes of life and death was beginning to spread. When two souls cross, history begins to move...

The anime stars:

• Taichi Kusano as Kū Bashin, a cheerful, positive, sincere fan of Battle Spirits who wants to become stronger

• Daiki Hamano as Zetsu Ajara, a cool, unapproachable rōnin, feared as an Eternal Battler master assassin

Masashi Kudo ( Terminator Zero , Sanrio Boys , Hayate the Combat Butler! Cuties ) is directing the anime at Bandai Namco Pictures and is also credited for the original character designs. Toshizo Nemoto ( Inu X Boku Secret Service , Metallic Rouge , Log Horizon two seasons) is in charge of series scripts. Bandai Namco Pictures is also credited for planning the production.

Bandai launched its original Battle Spirits trading card game in 2008. In the game, cards represent dragons, demons, birds, insects, and other spirits that the players can control in battles. Bandai imported the game to the United States in 2009. Battle Spirits: Connected Battlers , the latest video game in the franchise , launched for PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch in April 2022.

The franchise launched the 50-episode Battle Spirits: Shōnen Toppa Bashin anime series in September 2008. A new television anime series aired almost every year afterwards until 2016-2017's Battle Spirits Double Drive .

A three-episode net anime series titled Battle Spirits: Saga Brave then premiered in June 2019. Battle Spirits: Kakumei no Galett launched in August 2020. Battle Spirits: Mirage , the most recent anime in the franchise , premiered online in October 2021.

Ani-One Asia will debut the stream for Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume , the original television anime based on the Tetsudō Musume (Railway Girls) characters, on October 9 at 12:00 a.m. GMT +8. Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Wanting to break away from everyday life and find something she can truly be passionate about someday. Amidst a campus buzzing with excitement at the dawn of a new chapter, the ones who reach out a hand to Misaki are the members of the Railway Tourism Research Club. As she watches the world unfold along the train tracks, Misaki's heart begins to race with thrill! Traveling through the working world of the "Tetsudou Musume" as it celebrates its 20th anniversary, the Railtourism Club embarks on a journey in search of exciting sparks and wonders.

OMYTEC is credited for the original work in collaboration with I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level novel writer Kisetsu Morita . Misuzu Hoshino ( Laid-Back Camp episode director, Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable! , The Maid I Hired Recently Is Mysterious director) is directing the anime at East Fish Studio . Aya Satsuki ( Solo Camping for Two , "Ippon" Again! , Too Cute Crisis ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and Hisanori Hashimoto ( Laid-Back Camp season 3) is designing the characters. The Tetsuryo Club, comprised of the main voice actors: May Tachibana (Misaki), Mao Shōji (Kodama), Haruna Fukushima (Ushio), and Hika Tsukishiro (Usa) will perform the ending theme song "Watashi Miraisen" (My Future Line).

The Tetsudō Musume characters "work" in railway companies and railway-related businesses all over Japan, wearing real uniforms and work clothes. As of May 2025, there are 114 Tetsudō Musume all over Japan. Tetsudō Musume launched in 2005, and celebrated its 20th anniversary in 2025.

Superpowered Detective × Super-Strong Rookie Cop. An Unpredictable Supernatural Police Comedy!? A specialist in criminal investigations, Meguru Chojo uses every psychic ability imaginable, including lip-reading, clairvoyance, and telepathy. A rookie police officer and judo black belt, Ippongi Nao is nicknamed “Gorilla” because of her incredible strength. This ultimate (?) duo is on the job once again, keeping the peace in Chinjuku!

title: Sacnilk Estimates ₹8.46 Crore Indian Box Office Collection for New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil Anime Film
content:
The film opened in Indian theaters in Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu on Friday. The film had a premiere screening for fans on September 26 featuring character mascots from the franchise .

As the title indicates, this 45th 2D anime film (not counting the 3D CG Stand By Me Doraemon films) remakes the classic 1983 film Doraemon the Movie: Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil .

The film opened in Japan on February 27 and ranked at #1 in its first weekend. The film sold 621,000 tickets and earned 779,681,350 yen (about US$4.96 million) in its first three days. It ranked at #1 for six straight weekends. The film's release featured immersive "4D" screenings for the first time in the franchise .

Shōya Chiba voices the character El, a soldier of the Mu Federation tasked to keep an eye on Doraem on and his friends when they arrived at the bottom of the sea. Additionally, Ryō Hirohashi voices the Mizunaka Buggy (Underwater Buggy), the amphibious buggy car and one of Dorae mon's secret gadgets.

Actress Airi Taira is an ambassador for the film, along with comedy duo Alco & Peace. They voice soldiers in the film.

Tetsuo Yajima ( Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle , Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us , Pokémon XY ) returned after directing episodes of the Doraemon television anime and contributing in other capacities to Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's New Great Adventure into the Underworld , Doraemon the Movie: Nobita and the Steel Troops: The New Age , and Eiga Doraemon: Nobita no Chikyū Symphony . Another veteran of the television anime, Isao Murayama ( Witchy Precure! , Star Twinkle Precure , Bakugan ), wrote the new film's screenplay.

Eiga Doraemon: Nobita no Esekai Monogatari ( Doraemon: Nobita's Art World Tales ), the 44th film in the Doraemon franchise , opened in Japan in March 2025.
author: ANN

title: Aniplus Asia Airs Simulcast of Raccoon Dog & Fox Anime
content:
Aniplus Asia announced last Friday that it will air a simulcast of Raccoon Dog & Fox , the television anime based on Atamoto 's Tanuki to Kitsune (Raccoon Dog and Fox) manga. The simulcast will begin airing later today, October 5 at 8:30 p.m. GMT +8.

The cast members include:

• Misaki Kuno as Tanuki

• Nao Tōyama as Kitsune

• Toshiyuki Morikawa as Ōkami

• Maria Naganawa as Usagi and Narrator

• Takuma Nagatsuka as Kuma and Usagi

The manga's story centers on the daily lives of a raccoon dog who is not quite with it and a mischievous fox who likes to tease the raccoon dog. The two are close friends who live together on a mountain. Their other friends include a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and birds.

Tommy Hino ( Kumarba (TV 3) , Crane Game Girls ) is directing the anime at Akatsuki Media Studio , and Rika Kihara ( Sylvanian Families Freya no Piece of Secret ) is writing the scripts.

The anime celebrates the franchise 's 10th anniversary.

Atamoto began serializing the manga on X (formerly Twitter ), and Frontier Works releases the manga in print. The series has already inspired a wide variety of merchandise, as well as stamps on the LINE messaging and social media app.

The franchise contains the manga's 10 volumes and three picture book volumes. The second volume of a new manga series titled Tanuki to Kitsune Yurutto will ship on October 15. The overall book franchise has 1.35 million copies in circulation.

A previous series of web anime shorts debuted in February 2018.
author: ANN

title: Muse India, JioHotstar Streams Hitoribocchi no Marumaru Seikatsu Anime
content:
The anime premiered in April 2019.

Muse India describes its story:

Many of us know what it is like to transition to a new school with few to no friends in a new environment, going through the arduous process of getting to know people again. Bocchi Hitori knows this struggle all too well, having just graduated from elementary school and thrown into middle school. Unfortunately, she suffers from extreme social anxiety: she faints when overwhelmed, vomits when nervous, and draws up ridiculously convoluted plans to avoid social contact. It does not help that her only friend from elementary school, Kai Yawara, will not be attending the same middle school as Bocchi. However, wanting to help her, Kai severs ties with Bocchi and promises to reconcile with her when she befriends all of her classmates in her new middle school class. Even though Bocchi has no faith in herself, she is determined to be friends with Kai again. Summoning all of her courage, Bocchi takes on the daunting challenge of making friends with her entire class, starting with the delinquent-looking girl sitting in front of her...

Takebumi Anzai ( Go! Go! 575 director, episode director for Darker than Black and Mob Psycho 100 ) directed the anime at studio C2C ( Harukana Receive , WorldEnd ). Jukki Hanada ( Beyond the Boundary , Sound! Euphonium , Steins;Gate ) both oversaw and wrote the series scripts, and Kii Tanaka ( Donten ni Warau Gaiden: Ketsubetsu, Yamainu no Chikai , Cheating Craft ) was both the character designer and chief animation director. Ryuuichi Takada and Hidekazu Tanaka of monaca composed the music, and Shigeru Saitō of Heart Company produced the music at Kadokawa .

Katsuwo ( Mitsuboshi Colors ) serialized the manga in Kadokawa 's Comic Dengeki DaiohG magazine and ended it in April 2021.
author: ANN
